letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai reminds me of the golden glow you bring into my life, and each monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. I’m counting the moments until we’re together again, hand‑in‑hand, laughing over chai and camel‑cactus jokes. You are my forever cutie, the rhythm in my heart’s song, and I love you more with every step we take across continents. Thank you for being my anchor and my adventure, all at once.
poem:
In desert dunes or monsoon rain,  
Your smile’s the sunshine after the strain.  
Across the miles, our love’s a kite,  
Soaring higher, day and night.
